name: Python: PCAP-31-03 Certified Associate Python Programmer (Python Institute)
material_vintage: OpenEDG Python Institute PCAP-31-03 exam syllabus (status ACTIVE, page last updated 7 Mar 2022), fetched live on 2026-09-26 from pythoninstitute.org/pcap-exam-syllabus and itemised in full. Exam format: 40 items; single-select, multiple-select, code and scenario items; pass = cumulative 70%; section weights 12/14/18/34/22%. The Python Institute publishes no past papers, so every practice and test item is original, written to the published objectives. Exam-dump sites were deliberately not used. Every code-output answer key was generated by running the code (Python 3). Items on the platform module avoid machine-specific outputs.
level_source: standalone: a vendor certification with no RQF/FHEQ level
